full_judgment:
Mohammad Gholam Rabbani, J: This Rule has been obtained by petitioner Md. Nur Hossain for analogous hearing of the five suits pending in three different civil courts at Dhaka in respect of same property situated within P.S. Subujbag of the City of Dhaka. Opposite party No. 10 Mcd. Delowar Hossain in this Rule has instituted Title Suit No. 137 of 1993 in the 3rd court of subordinate judge for declaration of his title to the suit property. Opposite party No. 9 Jahura Begum in this rule has instituted Title Suit No. 131 of 1993 in the 4th court of Assistant judge for declaration of her title to the suit property petitioner in this rule has instituted two suits one being Title Suit No. 71 of 1993 in the 3rd Additional Court of Assistant judge, for permanent injunction in respect of the suit property, and the other being title suit No. 309 of 1989 in the 4th court of Assistant judge for declaration of title to the suit property. Opposite party Zahura .Begum obtained an ex-parte decree in title suit No. 44 of 1988 from the 4th court of Assistant Judge and put the decree in execution in Execution Case No. 1 of 1993. However, the ex-parte decree was set aside and title suit No. 44 of 1988 was restored to its original file and number and the suit is now pending. In this rule petitioner prays that all the suits be tried analogously by one court. 

 2. Mr. Mizanur Rahman Bhuiyan learned Advocate for the opposite parties opposes the rule on the ground that the suits are pending in different courts according to their respective valuation and as such there will he difficulty in disposing of the suits analogously by one court. 

 3. Since the parties are litigating claiming title to the same property by filing several suits, justice demands that all the stilts should be tried analogously by one court and as such objection of the learned advocate for the opposite party No. 9 is not acceptable. 

 5. It is ordered that all the suits, namely Title Suit No. 137 or 1993 pending in the 3rd court of Subordinate judge Dhaka, title Suit No. 71 of 1993 Pending in the 3rd Additional court of Assistant judge Dhaka title suit No. 131 of 1993 pending in the 4th court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka Title Suit No. 37 of 1992 pending in the 4th court of Assistant Judge. Dhaka and title Suit No. 44 of 1988 pending in the 4th court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka and title Suit No. 44 of 1988 pending in the 4th court of Assistant judge, Dhaka shall be tried analogously by the 3rd court of Subordinate judge. Dhaka Learned Presiding judges having the suits shall send the records of the respective suit to the 3rd court of Subordinate judge Dhaka immediately after the receipt this judgment and order. 

 7. Order of staying the further proceeding of the aforesaid suits passed at the time of issuance of the rule is hereby vacated.
